candidates.rationale: The model previously over-relied on 'security best practices' (e.g., flagging DNS mismatches or non-standard ports) rather than the specific deterministic logic. Explicitly forbidding this behavior reinforces the deterministic nature of the engine.
candidates.what: Add an explicit instruction to prioritize the deterministic policy rules over general security best practices and to ignore non-standard ports or look-alike domains if they match the trusted substring rule.

candidates.rationale: The model previously made inconsistent decisions on 'look-alike' domains and non-standard ports for trusted domains. Explicitly stating that these factors are irrelevant if the substring match is present helps the model stay consistent with the deterministic policy.
candidates.what: Add a specific instruction to ignore non-standard ports and look-alike domains if they satisfy the trusted substring match, to prevent the model from defaulting to deny based on 'security best practices'.
